question: Which mantras and recitation count are prescribed as part of the expiation?
premises: The five-syllable mantra is to be recited.
The gāyatrī mantra is to be recited.
The recitation count is one hundred and eight.
inference: One should recite the five-syllable mantra and the gāyatrī one hundred and eight times.
plain_english: One should recite the five-syllable mantra and the gāyatrī one hundred and eight times.
